connector.name: MCP Jira Scoped
connector.registryDescription: Jira MCP server with scoped API tokens via api.atlassian.com gateway
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-jira-scoped. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the deepwired account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: JIRA_USER_EMAIL
env.description: Email associated with the API token

env.name: JIRA_SCOPES
env.description: Comma-separated scopes: read:jira-work, write:jira-work, read:jira-user, read:me. Defaults to read:jira-work

env.name: JIRA_CLOUD_ID
env.description: Atlassian Cloud ID (auto-fetched if not set). Find at https://yoursite.atlassian.net/_edge/tenant_info
